newsitem.title: USA: H&R Block, Compuserve make appointments.
newsitem.headline: H&R Block, Compuserve make appointments.

text.p: H&R Block Inc said Monday it has named Frank Salizzoni president and chief executive.
Its subsidiary, CompuServe Corp , also announced it has named Salizzoni chairman of the board.

At CompuServe, Salizzoni replaces Henry Frigon, who served in the chairman's position on an interim basis. He will remain on the board, and Bob Massey continues as CompuServe's president and chief executive.
At H&R Block, Salizzoni has been president and chief executive on an interim basis since June 19.
